text:
# Insurer A · Senior Care: Policy Wording (summary)
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE. Fictional insurer and plan, written for the PS-04 Applied AI Challenge demo. Not a real policy.
Product: Health insurance for senior citizens (entry age 60 to 75)

## 1.1 Sum insured
Sum insured options: ₹3 lakh and ₹5 lakh per policy year.

## 2.1 Cashless treatment
Cashless treatment is available only at the insurer's network hospitals. Elsewhere, treatment is paid by the insured and reimbursed.

## 3.1 Initial waiting period
Initial waiting period: 30 days from the policy start date, except accidents.

## 3.3 Pre-existing disease waiting period
Pre-existing diseases declared at proposal are covered after a waiting period of 24 months of continuous cover.

## 4.2 Co-payment
Co-payment: 20% of every admissible claim is borne by the insured.

## 5.1 Claims
All claims are subject to the policy terms, conditions and exclusions and are decided by the insurer. No intermediary can guarantee approval of a claim.

## 5.2 No return of premium
This plan has no return of premium and no payout for a claim-free year.

## 6.1 Free-look period
Free-look period of 30 days from receipt of the policy document.

name: Insurer B · Health Secure Plus
text:
# Insurer B · Health Secure Plus: Policy Wording (summary)
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE. Fictional insurer and plan, written for the PS-04 Applied AI Challenge demo. Not a real policy.
Product: Health insurance (individual and family floater)

## 1.1 Sum insured
Sum insured options: ₹3 lakh, ₹5 lakh, ₹10 lakh and ₹25 lakh per policy year, as shown in the quote and the policy schedule.

## 2.1 Cashless treatment
Cashless treatment is available only at the insurer's network hospitals. At non-network hospitals the insured pays and claims reimbursement within 30 days of discharge.

## 3.1 Initial waiting period
Initial waiting period: 30 days from the first policy start date. No claim is payable for illness in this period, except accidents.

## 3.2 Specific illness waiting period
Specific illness waiting period: 24 months for listed conditions including cataract, hernia, joint replacement and kidney stones.

## 3.3 Pre-existing disease waiting period
Pre-existing diseases (PED), including diabetes, hypertension and thyroid disorders declared at proposal, are covered after a waiting period of 36 months of continuous cover. A pre-existing disease is not covered from day one.

## 4.1 Room rent
Room rent is limited to 1% of the sum insured per day. If a higher room category is chosen, associated expenses are paid proportionately.

## 4.2 Co-payment
Co-payment: 0% for insured persons aged up to 60 at entry.

## 5.1 Claims
All claims are subject to the policy terms, conditions and exclusions and are decided by the insurer. No intermediary can guarantee approval of a claim.

## 5.2 No return of premium
This plan has no return of premium, no maturity benefit and no payout for a claim-free year.

## 6.1 Free-look period
The policyholder has a free-look period of 30 days from receipt of the policy document to review it and cancel for a refund, less proportionate risk premium and expenses.

name: Insurer C · Comprehensive Car Cover with zero depreciation
text:
# Insurer C · Comprehensive Car Cover with zero depreciation: Policy Wording (summary)
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE. Fictional insurer and plan, written for the PS-04 Applied AI Challenge demo. Not a real policy.
Product: Motor insurance, private car, comprehensive with zero depreciation add-on

## 1.1 Insured declared value
The insured declared value (IDV) is the value shown in the quote and the policy schedule.

## 2.1 Cashless repairs
Cashless repairs are available only at the insurer's network garages. At other garages the insured pays and claims reimbursement.

## 3.1 Compulsory deductible
A compulsory deductible of ₹1,000 applies to every own-damage claim.

## 3.2 Zero depreciation add-on
Zero depreciation cover is limited to 2 claims per policy year. Further claims are settled with depreciation on parts.

## 3.3 Engine protection
Engine damage caused by water ingress or hydrostatic lock is not covered without the engine protect add-on.

## 5.1 Claims
All claims are subject to the policy terms, conditions and exclusions and are decided by the insurer. No intermediary can guarantee approval of a claim.

## 5.2 No return of premium
This policy has no return of premium.

# Insurer E · Car Shield comprehensive: Policy Wording (summary)
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE. Fictional insurer and plan, written for the PS-04 Applied AI Challenge demo. Not a real policy.
Product: Motor insurance, private car, comprehensive (for customers switching insurer)

## 1.1 Insured declared value
The insured declared value (IDV) is the value shown in the quote and the policy schedule.

## 2.1 Cashless repairs
Cashless repairs are available only at the insurer's network garages.

## 3.1 Compulsory deductible
A compulsory deductible of ₹1,000 applies to every own-damage claim.

## 4.1 No-claim bonus transfer
The no-claim bonus (NCB) from the previous insurer is transferred only on submission of proof of NCB from the previous policy. Without proof, the policy is issued without NCB.

## 5.1 Claims
All claims are subject to the policy terms, conditions and exclusions and are decided by the insurer. No intermediary can guarantee approval of a claim.

## 5.2 No return of premium
This policy has no return of premium.
